entry.content: API GatewayFeatureConfigure streaming for LLM responses and other trafficYou can now create API Gateway gateways that stream requests and responses instead of buffering them. This Public Preview feature supports incremental response delivery over HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer encoding, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, and gRPC bidirectional streaming.
